2607.07507.title: HIVE: Understanding Post-Hallucination Reasoning in Vision Language Models
2607.07507.paper_summary: Hallucinations in vision language models (VLMs) are commonly treated as semantic errors, yet they often arise from partial or ambiguous visual evidence. Prior work mainly focuses on detecting or suppressing hallucinations at generation time, leaving the subsequent reasoning stage largely unexplored. In this work, we study Post Hallucination Reasoning (PHR), the stage in which hallucinated semantics enter the model's inference context and influence downstream predictions. To systematically investigate PHR, we introduce HIVE, Hallucination Inference and Verification Engine, an evaluation infrastructure that enables controlled comparisons between faithful and hallucinated captions. Across nine tasks and nine models, we observe structured modality dependent patterns: hallucinated captions often improve accuracy on vision language tasks, while text only tasks exhibit limited or unstable effects. Further analyses show that hallucinated cues broaden semantic coverage and reshape reasoning dynamics while preserving stable inference. These findings highlight that hallucinated semantics may influence downstream reasoning once they enter the model's inference context. Understanding this post hallucination stage is important for improving the reliability and interpretability of multimodal reasoning systems. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/hefengcs/HIVE.
2607.07507.paper_summary_zh: 視覺語言模型（VLMs）中的幻覺通常被視為語義錯誤，但它們往往源於部分或模糊的視覺證據。先前的研究主要集中在生成時檢測或抑制幻覺，對隨後的推理階段則幾乎未進行探討。在本研究中，我們研究了後幻覺推理（PHR），即幻覺語義進入模型推理上下文並影響下游預測的階段。為了系統性地研究PHR，我們引入了HIVE，幻覺推理與驗證引擎，這是一個評估基礎設施，能夠在真實和幻覺標題之間進行控制比較。在九個任務和九個模型中，我們觀察到結構化的模態依賴模式：幻覺標題通常提高視覺語言任務的準確性，而僅文本任務則表現出有限或不穩定的效果。進一步的分析顯示，幻覺線索擴大了語義覆蓋範圍，並重塑了推理動態，同時保持穩定的推理。這些發現突顯了幻覺語義在進入模型的推理上下文後可能影響下游推理的重要性。理解這一後幻覺階段對於提高多模態推理系統的可靠性和可解釋性至關重要。代碼可在 https://github.com/hefengcs/HIVE 上公開獲得。
